text:
Marta: Quick check — I'm seeing an alert for 'prefix_cache_hitrate_low' for model-realtime in prod. Where do we look for the canonical dashboard and alert thresholds? Anyone own tuning these alerts?

Henry: I can take a look. Which cluster/region?

Marta: us-west-2, dedicated pool dpool-prod-1. Alert fired at 03:42, hit-rate dropped to ~28% over 5m.

Logan: FYI prefetch was disabled for that pool last deploy? Not sure, tagging @DevOps.

DevOps: @Marta we're on it. Can you paste the raw alert JSON?

Marta: pasted below:
```json
{ "alert": "prefix_cache_hitrate_low", "expr": "(rate(kv_prefix_hits_total{pool='dpool-prod-1',env='prod'}[5m]) / rate(kv_prefix_requests_total{pool='dpool-prod-1',env='prod'}[5m])) * 100 < 35" }
```

Olivia: Dashboard is at https://grafana.redwood.company/d/kv-prefix/kv-prefix-overview (folder eng-platform -> caching). Main panels: 'Prefix hit % (5m)', 'Top-missed-prefixes', 'Prefetch latency'.

Sara: Quick Grafana query I use for traces/logs:
```
# PromQL for hit rate
( sum by(prefix)(increase(kv_prefix_hits_total{env="prod"}[5m])) / sum by(prefix)(increase(kv_prefix_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m])) ) * 100

# Loki to find prefetch errors
{job="kv-proxy", pool="dpool-prod-1"} |= "prefetch" |= "error"
```

Henry: If prefetch was disabled, hit-rate drop makes sense. Two options: re-enable prefetch on the pool or raise alert threshold temporarily. I can push a 1-line change to the alertmanager rule: bump from 35 -> 30 for next 24h while we investigate. @Marta ok with that?

Marta: fine with temporary tweak. Can you add a note in the alert's runbook?

Henry: will do, linking runbook: https://confluence.redwood.company/eng-platform/kv-cache-runbook#prefetch

Deploy-bot: alertmanager rule update merged by Henry — change id am-rule-452 — will deploy in 2m.

Marta: Thanks — also, if someone can pull the top 10 missed prefixes for the 03:30-04:00 window that'd be great.

Olivia: grabbing that now, will post results in thread.

Olivia: Top missed prefixes (03:30-04:00):
1) model/llama-70b/context
2) model/rlhf-finetune/checkpoints
3) user/anon/session/*
(remaining list posted to the dashboard panel 'Top-missed-prefixes') :eyes:

Marta: helpful — looks like a spike of novel prefixes from a load test. I'll coordinate with the QA team to stop the test and then we'll re-evaluate.

Sara: After QA stops, also recommend running the prefetch warmup job for that pool: `kubectl -n inference jobs create prefetch-warmup --image=registry/prefetch:latest --args='--pool dpool-prod-1 --prefix-file s3://redwood-metrics/warmup-prefixes.txt'`

Marta: noted. Thanks all. I'll update this thread after QA confirms. :thumbsup:
